recent.text: I don't know if Derrick White is hurt or if he's lost it, but after tonight he's shooting 40.1% overall and 28.8% on threes so far this season. This is after hitting 39.4% overall and 32.7% on threes last season. Three full seasons prior: 45.4% overall and 38.7% on threes.

recent.text: For the first time in five years, the Celtics played in a game in which neither team reached 90 points. The last time was by the exact same score – an 88-87 win over Philly on 12/1/21, when Rob Williams blocked Georges Niang's 3-pointer at the buzzer. https://t.co/BVhNiMbSNC

recent.text: Another tough one for the Celtics, who fall in a 90s-type battle in Golden State, 88-87. Tatum had a chance to win it on the final shot but Draymond played great defense and forced the miss off the front of the rim.

recent.text: Jayson Tatum logged the 137th 20-point half of his career tonight with 23 points during the first half at Golden State. That moves him past Paul George into 25th all-time in 20-point halves.

recent.text: How fitting is this? Jayson Tatum passes Bill Russell into 8th place on the Celtics' all-time scoring list with a shot from the Bay Bridge logo in San Fransisco, where Russell starred in college. https://t.co/ENXuHv5XmO

recent.text: With that three-pointer, Tatum passed Bill Russell for 8th place on the Celtics' all-time scoring list and completed a 23-point, 8-rebound first half. Tatum: 14,524 ... Russell: 14,522 While Tatum had 23, the rest of the team combined for just 19 points on 8 of 29 FG
